selected_opcode_semantics.effect: Read first and second scalar values; write second + first to second operand through 404B30.
Read first and second scalar values; write second - first to second operand through 404B30.
Call copy helper(first resolved operand, offset=0, second resolved operand). Scalar path writes first value into second.
Call copy helper(first resolved operand, scalar value of third resolved operand, second resolved operand).
Signed scalar comparison first versus second. Clear flags bits 0x0E; set 0x04 for equality, 0x02 if first < second, 0x08 if first > second.
Set byte at 4274C4 to 1; return the raw word at first resolved operand +2 as VM step status through 4044A1. Meaning of the status and flag remains unknown.
OR low 8 bits of first scalar value into flags word 42757C. Does not itself establish an error or termination.
Clear flags selected by low 8 bits of first scalar value. If value bit 0 selected, also clear word 427644.

scalar_helpers.other_write_tags: no scalar memory write; 427580 still assigned operand pointer

copy_helper_observations.scalar_path: First B1/B2/B4 value is converted at matching width then scalar-written to second.
copy_helper_observations.b0_path: First B0 source starts at first+6+offset with bound word(first+4)-offset; second B0 destination starts at second+6+offset with bound word(second+2)-offset. Scalar sides use operand+2 and width 1/2/4. Copy count is signed-16-bit minimum of bounds. B0 sides step -1; scalar sides step +1. For negative steps, starting pointer additionally advances count-1.
copy_helper_observations.destination_b0_metadata: Second B0 word+4 set to count for offset zero; otherwise increased to offset+count when greater.
copy_helper_observations.flag_0x10: Set if signed second-side bound is less than first-side bound, cleared otherwise.
unknowns: No semantic labeling of B0 header words as length/capacity beyond observed native accesses.
No host packet, controller erase, program or physical outcome inferred from copy semantics.
Descriptor resolution helper 4044A8 not fully traced.
